:::note[Source]
This page is generated from [`persona.example.yaml`](https://github.com/zyziyun/reelfold/blob/main/persona.example.yaml) in the repository, the same file the engine and the Claude Code skill read.
:::

Everything that is taste rather than technique lives in one file. Copy the example and edit it:

```bash
cp persona.example.yaml persona.local.yaml   # in the skill folder; git-ignored
```

The Mac app keeps the same settings under **Settings**; the skill reads `persona.local.yaml`. Any key you leave out keeps the default shown here.

> Creator persona: every taste/brand/platform default the workflows read. Copy to persona.local.yaml (gitignored) and edit; it overrides these keys.

## Sections

| Section | What it sets | Keys |
|---|---|---|
| [`creator`](#creator) | Your name and handle (covers, end cards) and the language you speak in your videos. | `name`, `handle`, `language` |
| [`platforms`](#platforms) | Default platform and per-platform overrides deep-merged over the built-in profiles. | `default`, `xiaohongshu`, `youtube` |
| [`speed`](#speed) | Playback rates used when you just say "speed it up" (hook, body, B-roll). | `hook`, `body`, `fast_hook`, `fast_body`, `b_roll`, `cjk_max_intelligible` |
| [`audio`](#audio) | Delivery loudness, narration and music levels, pause squeezing. | `loudness_lufs`, `voice_lufs`, `music_lufs`, `pause_squeeze`, `pause_threshold` |
| [`export`](#export) | Frame rate, quality, audio bitrate, colour tags and the H.264 encoder. | `fps`, `crf`, `audio_bitrate`, `colour` |
| [`style`](#style) | The design theme every overlay, card and caption uses. | `theme` |
| [`brand`](#brand) | Your ink and ground colours. | `ink`, `ground` |
| [`fonts`](#fonts) | Your own font files per role (cjk, cjk-bold, cjk-serif, serif, mono…), including one face of a .ttc. |  |
| [`subtitles`](#subtitles) | Caption line length, keyword highlight markup and ASR term fixes. | `max_cjk_chars`, `max_en_chars`, `highlight_markup`, `term_fixes`, `glossary` |
| [`voice`](#voice) | Voice rules for scripts and post copy. | `persona`, `rules` |
| [`publish`](#publish) | Default hashtags, named tag sets and the chapter line format. | `tags`, `tag_sets`, `chapter_line` |
| [`intake`](#intake) | How the planner treats materials (for example burned-in captions). | `burned_captions` |
| [`cleanup`](#cleanup) | Default cleanup profile, crossfade, extra fillers and words never to cut. | `profile`, `crossfade`, `fillers_extra`, `never_cut` |
| [`formats`](#formats) | recurring formats (python -m vstudio.formats list): first-pass defaults per kind of post. |  |

## Full example, section by section

### `creator`

```yaml
creator:
  name: ""                 # used on covers/end cards when set
  handle: ""
  language: zh             # subtitle + caption language for the creator's own speech
```

### `platforms`

```yaml
platforms:
  # Full per-platform profiles (canvas, UI safe zones, caption band/size, length, LUFS, encode, cover,
  # title/description limits) live in lib/vstudio/platform.py (sources: references/PLATFORMS.md).
  # Anything under platforms.<name> is deep-merged over those defaults; per-orientation overrides go
  # under platforms.<name>.orientations.<vertical|full|horizontal>.
  default: xiaohongshu     # xiaohongshu | douyin | tiktok | youtube | youtube-shorts | bilibili
  xiaohongshu:
    post_shape: vertical   # shape when only "小红书" is said (intake / plans): vertical = 3:4 (1080x1440), full = 9:16
    title_max: 20          # 小红书 counts CJK = 1, latin/digit/space = 0.5 (vstudio.config.xhs_len)
    cover_aspect: "3:4"    # vertical posts; horizontal posts show a 4:3 centre crop
    safe_zone: {top: 240, bottom: 1660, right_lower_keepout: 160}   # legacy form, 1080x1920 ("full") canvas
    # orientations:
    #   vertical: {caption: {band: [1060, 1260], size: [56, 76]}}   # e.g. bigger captions on 3:4
  youtube:
    title_max: 100
    cover_aspect: "16:9"
  # douyin:
  #   loudness: {lufs: -12, tp: -1.0}   # a hotter short-form master, if you prefer
  #   length: {sweet: [20, 45]}
```

### `speed`

```yaml
speed:                     # playback rates used when the creator just says "speed it up"
  hook: 1.3
  body: 1.1
  fast_hook: 1.6
  fast_body: 1.3
  b_roll: 1.1              # inserted footage (e.g. a highlights montage)
  cjk_max_intelligible: 1.4
```

### `audio`

```yaml
audio:
  loudness_lufs: -14       # delivery loudness (two-pass loudnorm)
  voice_lufs: -16          # narration stem before mixing
  music_lufs: -30          # bed level before carving under the voice
  pause_squeeze: 0.06      # 气口 target gap in seconds
  pause_threshold: 0.35    # gaps longer than this get squeezed
```

### `export`

```yaml
export:
  fps: 30
  crf: 18
  # h264_encoder: libx264   # libx264 | h264_videotoolbox | h264_mf; env VSTUDIO_H264_ENCODER wins (lib/vstudio/h264.py)
  audio_bitrate: 192k
  colour: bt709
```

### `style`

```yaml
style:
  theme: editorial         # editorial | mono | soft | night | xhs-pop (classic = the old red look); see
                           # references/STYLE_RULES.md. Tokens can be tinted here, e.g. accent: "#3E5C76"
                           # Per client: client.yaml theme; per recipe: the project's theme param; per output:
                           # the output-edit `theme` op ("换成更高级的配色").
```

### `brand`

```yaml
brand:
  # accent / highlight follow style.theme. Setting brand.accent / highlight WITHOUT a style.theme keeps the
  # old look (theme classic with these colours), e.g. accent: "#FF2442", highlight: "#FFD60A"
  ink: "#ECEEF2"
  ground: "#0B1020"        # premium dark plate
  # panel_theme: notes-red # legacy notes panel (notes-red | notes-yellow | teal | navy); default = the theme's card
```

### `fonts`

```yaml
fonts: {}                  # override any role with your own file, e.g. cjk-bold: ~/Fonts/MyFont.ttf
```

### `subtitles`

```yaml
subtitles:
  max_cjk_chars: 18
  max_en_chars: 90
  highlight_markup: "【】"  # 【term】 is emphasised the theme's way (marker band / accent), one per line
  term_fixes: {}           # ASR corrections, e.g. {"cloud code": "Claude Code"}
  glossary: {}             # bilingual captions: fixed translations {source term: target term}, e.g. {"break the ice": "打破僵局"}
```

### `voice`

```yaml
voice:                     # style rules for scripts and post copy (see workflows/preproduction)
  persona: "practitioner sharing what they figured out"
  rules:
    - no em-dashes
    - no parentheses in spoken lines
    - one 干货 reframe per piece
    - no generic CTA
```

### `publish`

```yaml
publish:
  tags: []                 # default hashtags appended to post copy (post_body use_persona_tags=True)
  tag_sets: {}             # named alternatives picked per post with tag_set:, e.g. {art: [看展, 艺术]}
                           # a post/spec can also set use_persona_tags: false to use only its own tags
  chapter_line: "时间线在下面，按需跳👇"
```

### `intake`

```yaml
intake:                    # one sentence + materials -> plan (python -m vstudio.intake)
  burned_captions: band    # a finished edit with burned-in captions, cut again: band = crop the old captions off,
                           # picture in a band, new captions below; keep = leave the old captions, add none
```

### `cleanup`

```yaml
cleanup:                   # shared 气口 / filler / repeat tool (python -m vstudio.cleanup, references/CLEANUP.md)
  profile: standard        # default profile: gentle | standard | tight (vlog / photo-story speech clips use gentle)
  crossfade: 0.02          # seconds (20 ms) equal-power crossfade at every join; keep within 0.01-0.03
  fillers_extra: []        # your own 口头禅, treated like 那个 / 就是, e.g. [其实, 对不对]
  never_cut: []            # tokens never flagged as filler / repeat, e.g. [然后]
  # policy: true           # answer low-risk confirm edits automatically (batch stages do by default); learned
  #                        # answers live in ~/.config/vstudio/cleanup_policy.json (or policy_file: <path>)
```

### `formats`

```yaml
formats: {}                # recurring formats (python -m vstudio.formats list): first-pass defaults per kind of post.
```
